title: Swidget's Song Player
description: Swidget's Song Player is a Minecraft 1.21.11 mod that adds a GUI in the Options menu for playing Minecraft OSTs in-game.
body:
# Swidget's Song Player

Swidget's Song Player is a client-side Minecraft Java 1.21.11 mod that adds a built-in music player GUI to the Options menu, allowing players to listen to multiple Minecraft OST tracks directly in-game.

The mod is designed for players who want more control over Minecraft’s soundtrack experience while playing survival, PvP, building, exploration, or roleplay. Using the simple GUI, players can select and switch between available songs without needing commands or external music software.

## Features

* In-game music player GUI
* Accessible through the Minecraft Options menu
* Multiple Minecraft OST tracks included
* Lightweight and simple design
* Seamless music switching
* Client-side functionality

## Compatibility

* Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.11
* Requires Fabric mod loader

## Notes

Swidget's Song Player is intended for entertainment and customization purposes only. The mod does not provide gameplay advantages or modify multiplayer mechanics.
